phase: Block 125 — Review-Gated Approval & Stale Approval Protection
objective: Implement a review-gated human approval mechanism that cryptographically and version-wise binds an approval decision to the exact immutable review artifact that was reviewed.

approvalContract.contentHash: Exact SHA-256 cryptographic binding over canonicalized review payload
approvalContract.concurrencyVersion: Session concurrency version at decision time
approvalContract.immutabilityHash: Cryptographic SHA-256 hash of the complete approval record payload

staleApprovalMechanism.isApprovalCurrent: Boolean check enforcing exact 5-point session, artifact ID, version, and content hash identity
staleApprovalMechanism.evaluateApprovalStatus: Deep structured diagnosis returning STALE upon version/hash/identity mismatch, INVALID upon session/project/corruption mismatch, or APPROVED/REJECTED

authorizationPath: securityService.evaluatePermission(auth, 'APPROVE', 'IMPORT_OPERATION', projectId, state) with strict role verification (read-only roles rejected).
auditPath: auditService.logAuditEvent emitting immutable append-only event with complete artifact and hash details.
concurrencyMechanism: session.version === concurrency.expectedVersion checked against ImportSessionManager before transition.
sessionTransition: REVIEW_REQUIRED -> APPROVED (or REJECTED); zero APPROVED -> COMMITTING transitions implemented.
storageBehavior: In-memory append-only registry per session; zero Firestore production mutations or schema additions.
